project: Withers Road Partial Upgrade, North Kellyville NSW 2155 for The Hills Shire Council
scope_of_works: Road widening to a four-lane cross-section, T-intersection reconstruction, and associated civil and infrastructure works within the existing road corridor. Includes demolition and removal of existing pavement, kerb and gutter, and footpath; bulk earthworks and road formation; sub-base and road base placement; stormwater drainage infrastructure; Sydney Water asset relocation; concrete kerb, gutter, footpaths, pedestrian ramps and shared path; intersection reconstruction with asphalt, line marking, and kerb returns; traffic signal installation and commissioning; street lighting modifications; final asphalt surfacing, line marking, pavement markers, signage, and road furniture. Works under approved CTMP with traffic control at all times.
quick_scan_focus: Sydney Water asset relocation and hold points
